parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vmm_complaints WHERE is_deleted = 'No' AND DATE(created) BETWEEN '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.from }}' AND '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.to }}') AS total_logged, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vmm_complaintlogs WHERE status = 'Escalated' AND DATE(created) BETWEEN '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.from }}' AND '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.to }}') AS escalated, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vmm_complaintlogs WHERE status IN ('Closed','Resolved') AND DATE(created) BETWEEN '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.from }}' AND '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.to }}') AS closed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vmm_complaints c LEFT JOIN vmm_complaintlogs cl ON cl.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vmm_complaintlogs WHERE complaintid = c.id) LEFT JOIN vmm_vendorescalations ve ON ve.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vmm_vendorescalations WHERE complaintid = c.id) WHERE c.is_deleted = 'No' AND (cl.status IS NULL OR cl.status NOT IN ('Closed','Resolved')) AND ve.closuredate IS NOT NULL AND ve.closuredate < CURDATE()) AS edcs_pending

SELECT c.id, c.complaintno, c.productname, c.vendorname, cs.storecode, cs.storename AS store_name, cs.storecity AS city, COALESCE(cl.status, 'Open') AS status, ve.closuredate, CASE WHEN ve.closuredate IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ve.closuredate) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ve.closuredate) ELSE NULL END AS days_overdue FROM vmm_complaints c LEFT JOIN vmm_complaintstores cs ON cs.id = c.storerefid LEFT JOIN vmm_vendorescalations ve ON ve.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vmm_vendorescalations WHERE complaintid = c.id) LEFT JOIN vmm_complaintlogs cl ON cl.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vmm_complaintlogs WHERE complaintid = c.id) WHERE c.is_deleted = 'No' AND (cl.status IS NULL OR cl.status NOT IN ('Closed','Resolved')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ve.closuredate IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ve.closuredate) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.created DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT u.id AS uid, u.name AS agent_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.id) FROM vmm_complaints c2 LEFT JOIN vmm_complaintstores cs2 ON cs2.id = c2.storerefid WHERE cs2.uid = u.id AND c2.is_deleted = 'No') AS logged, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vmm_complaintlogs cl2 WHERE cl2.uid = u.id AND cl2.status = 'Escalated' AND DATE(cl2.created) BETWEEN '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.from }}' AND '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.to }}') AS escalated, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vmm_complaintlogs cl2 WHERE cl2.uid = u.id AND cl2.status IN ('Closed','Resolved') AND DATE(cl2.created) BETWEEN '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.from }}' AND '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.to }}') AS closed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vmm_complaintlogs cl2 WHERE cl2.uid = u.id AND cl2.status = 'Update EDC' AND DATE(cl2.created) BETWEEN '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.from }}' AND '{{ $('Extract Params').first().json.to }}') AS update_edc, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.id) FROM vmm_complaints c2 LEFT JOIN vmm_complaintstores cs2 ON cs2.id = c2.storerefid LEFT JOIN vmm_complaintlogs cl3 ON cl3.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vmm_complaintlogs WHERE complaintid = c2.id) WHERE cs2.uid = u.id AND c2.is_deleted = 'No' AND (cl3.status IS NULL OR cl3.status NOT IN ('Closed','Resolved'))) AS open FROM vmm_users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vmm_complaintstores cs JOIN vmm_complaints c ON c.storerefid = cs.id AND c.is_deleted = 'No' WHERE cs.uid = u.id) ORDER BY logged DESC
